content: Disney is bringing more than 60 3D movies to the Disney Plus app on Meta Quest. The movies will be available to Disney Plus subscribers as part of an updated Disney Plus app that’s rolling out today. The 3D movies you can check out include The Avengers and Black Panther, Meta says. But the updated Quest app doesn’t just offer 3D movies; you’ll also be able to see some films in themed, immersive virtual environments, like a Tatooine environment when watching Star Wars: A New Hope or a Scare Floor one for Monsters, Inc. I got to see an Avengers-themed immersive environment for myself while trying Meta’s forthcoming VR Glasses in September, and while it was novel for the few minutes I tried it, I wasn’t sure if it would be good during an entire movie. The Disney Plus app on the VR Glasses, which are set to release sometime in spring 2027, will also let you watch IMAX Enhanced movies, including Avengers: Endgame, Lightyear, and Tron: Ares. The VR Glasses will also be a place to watch 3D movies from Lionsgate.

chineseContent: 迪士尼将在 Meta Quest 上的 Disney Plus 应用程序中引入 60 多部 3D 电影。这些电影将作为今天推出的更新后的迪士尼+应用程序的一部分提供给迪士尼+订阅者。 Meta 说，你可以观看的 3D 电影包括《复仇者联盟》和《黑豹》。但更新后的 Quest 应用程序不仅提供 3D 电影，还提供 3D 电影。你还可以在主题化的沉浸式虚拟环境中观看一些电影，例如观看《星球大战：新希望》时的塔图因环境或《怪物公司》的恐怖地板。我在 9 月份尝试 Meta 即将推出的 VR 眼镜时亲眼目睹了以复仇者联盟为主题的沉浸式环境，虽然在尝试的几分钟内很新颖，但我不确定在整部电影中它是否会很好。 VR 眼镜上的 Disney+ 应用程序将于 2027 年春季发布，您还可以观看 IMAX 增强版电影，包括《复仇者联盟：终局之战》、《光年》和《创：战神》。 VR 眼镜也将成为观看狮门影业 3D 电影的地方。
